title: Portugal
dek: A nine-day guided loop from Lisbon with Portugal Motorcycle Tours: up the Atlantic coast to Porto, north to the Minho and Peneda-Gerês, through the Douro Valley, south on the N2, and home across the Alentejo by Marvão and Évora.

days.label: Day 1
days.title: Lisbon up the Atlantic coast
prose: Out of Lisbon and onto the back roads of the west coast: fishing and surfing villages, orchards, and the ocean alongside most of the way north to Nazaré and São Pedro de Moel.

photos.cap: Bikes lined up in Lisbon on the first morning
Sunset over the Atlantic at São Pedro de Moel
The bikes at the hotel, São Pedro de Moel

days.label: Day 2
days.title: Porto
prose: A short coastal run into Porto and a food tour through the city’s small eateries.

photos.cap: Largo de São Domingos at night

dining: Dinner on the square in the old town.

days.label: Day 3
days.title: Into the Douro Valley
prose: East into the Douro, the world’s oldest demarcated wine region, following the river through terraced vineyards to Quinta de la Rosa above Pinhão, in the middle of the harvest.

photos.cap: Lunch at Quinta de la Rosa
Harvest grapes fresh off the vines
Pressed grape skins from the harvest

days.label: Day 4
days.title: A day on the Douro
prose: Off the bikes: out on the river by boat, along the Douro by train, and into the port lodges.

photos.cap: Out on the Douro by boat
A glass of wine on the river

days.label: Day 5
days.title: North into the Minho
prose: North out of the Douro through green-wine country toward the mountains of the Minho, by way of Casa do Penedo, the little house built into the boulders near Fafe.

photos.cap: Casa do Penedo, the house in the rocks
A game of pool after dinner

days.label: Day 6
days.title: Peneda-Gerês to Braga
prose: Through Peneda-Gerês, Portugal’s only national park: granite ridges, oak and pine forest and stone villages, then down to Braga for the night.

photos.cap: A coffee stop in the mountains
The Arco da Porta Nova, Braga

days.label: Day 7
days.title: South through the mountains
prose: South through the mountains and gorges of the interior to Quinta Lusitania, a manor house near Santa Comba Dão, for the night.

photos.cap: Mountain gorges on the way south

days.label: Day 8
days.title: Down the N2 to Marvão
prose: South on the N2, Portugal’s longest road and its answer to Route 66, and on to the hilltop fortress of Marvão on the Spanish border.

photos.cap: A church lit up at night

days.label: Day 9
days.title: The Alentejo and back to Lisbon
prose: Out of Marvão across the cork-oak plains of the Alentejo by Elvas and Évora, and back to Lisbon to close the loop.

photos.cap: The Roman Temple of Diana, Évora

dining: The farewell dinner with the group.

callout.name: Portugal Motorcycle Tours — North Tour
callout.text: This loop was the guided North Tour from Lisbon: the Atlantic coast, a food tour in Porto, the Douro Valley, Trás-os-Montes, Peneda-Gerês and the N2 back south. Highly recommended if you want to ride Portugal with people who know every back road.
